description: Catalogue of AI model providers NPDev knows about. Single source of truth for `npdev providers` (key vault + connectivity test + export into an app's secrets/agent-proxy.env) AND for the AI authoring benchmark's allowlist (scripts/ai/bench). Owner decision 2026-10-19: no paid API spend -- the bench refuses any provider whose kind is 'paid' unless --allow-paid is passed. kind: local = runs on this machine, free = hosted free tier, paid = billed. keyEnvVar is the NPDev convention NPDEV_EXTERNALAI_<ID>_API_KEY; the key itself NEVER appears in this file. defaultModel is a hint only: run `npdev providers models <id>` to see what the account can actually call. appVendor is true only for vendors the generated apps' external-ai-http adapter speaks today.

providers.name: Google Gemini (AI Studio free tier)
providers.notes: Daily quota is small and 429/503 are common under load.

providers.name: NVIDIA API catalog (free developer tier)
providers.notes: Many models listed by /models answer 404 for a given account; probe before using one.

providers.name: Groq (free tier)
providers.notes: Very fast; tight per-minute token limits.

providers.name: Cerebras Inference (free tier)
providers.notes: Model names change; use `npdev providers models cerebras`.

providers.name: OpenRouter (':free' models only)
providers.notes: ONLY model ids ending ':free' are free; any other model id on this endpoint is billed. The bench refuses a non-':free' model id for this provider.

providers.name: Mistral La Plateforme (free Experiment tier)
providers.notes: Free only while the workspace is on the Experiment plan; make sure no billing is attached.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.notes: No key. CPU-only machines are very slow (a 3B model took ~50 min per bench prompt).

providers.name: Anthropic (paid)
providers.notes: Billed. Stored for generated apps; the benchmark refuses it without --allow-paid.

providers.name: OpenAI (paid)
providers.notes: Billed. Stored for generated apps; the benchmark refuses it without --allow-paid.
